questions.question: What was the 2020 Census population for the Albuquerque, NM metropolitan area?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()

pop_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Population' in str(c)][0]
row = data[data.iloc[:, 0] == 'Albuquerque, NM']
result = int(row[pop_col].values[0])

questions.question: Between Austin-Round Rock-Georgetown, TX and Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington, TX, which area recorded a higher 8-hour ozone concentration in 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()

cbsa_col = data.columns[0]
o3_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Ozone' in str(c)][0]

c1 = 'Austin-Round Rock-Georgetown, TX'
c2 = 'Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington, TX'

v1 = float(data[data[cbsa_col] == c1][o3_col].values[0])
v2 = float(data[data[cbsa_col] == c2][o3_col].values[0])

result = c1 if v1 > v2 else c2

questions.question: How many statistical areas in the 2025 summary had a 2020 Census population of 5,000,000 or greater?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()

pop_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Population' in str(c)][0]
pop = pd.to_numeric(data[pop_col], errors='coerce')
result = int((pop >= 5000000).sum())

questions.question: Which three statistical areas recorded the highest 24-hour PM10 concentrations in 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()

cbsa_col = data.columns[0]
pm10_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'PM10' in str(c)][0]

data['pm10_val'] = pd.to_numeric(data[pm10_col], errors='coerce')
top3 = data.dropna(subset=['pm10_val']).sort_values('pm10_val', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[cbsa_col].tolist()

questions.question: What was the total 2020 Census population across all statistical areas in Puerto Rico listed in the report?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()

cbsa_col = data.columns[0]
pop_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Population' in str(c)][0]

pr_data = data[data[cbsa_col].astype(str).str.endswith(', PR')].copy()
result = int(pd.to_numeric(pr_data[pop_col], errors='coerce').sum())

questions.question: Did any statistical area report a weighted annual mean sulfur dioxide (SO2) level of 10 ppb or higher in 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('epa_air_quality_statistics_by_city_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='AQ Stats by City 2025', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Core Based Statistical Area', na=False)].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_row]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()

so2_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'SO2' in str(c) and 'Wtd AM' in str(c)][0]
so2_vals = pd.to_numeric(data[so2_col], errors='coerce')
result = 'yes' if (so2_vals >= 10).any() else 'no'
